response.overview: He was the acclaimed film director who had the voice of the youth and the ear of the powerful. His fall from grace was steep when he was accused of, and admitted to, sexually abusing a 13-year-old boy who had appeared in his films. In this documentary series, journalist Negra Efendić seeks the truth about Staffan Hildebrand.
